newsitem.title: YEMEN: Somali, Ethiopian refugees arrive in Yemen.
newsitem.headline: Somali, Ethiopian refugees arrive in Yemen.

text.p: More than 75 Somali and Ethiopian refugees have infiltrated into Yemen where they were arrested on a deserted beach, a weekly newspaper reported.
Al-Ayam said on Wednesday the refugees had wanted to sail to Saudi Arabia but the ship carrying them "left them on the beach" in Taiz province south of the capital Sanaa this week.
"The refugees were taken to the central prison in Taiz," it said. It did not say what the fate of the refugees would be.

Yemen is home to some 20,000 Somali refugees, who fled to the impoverished Arab state after war broke out in Somalia in 1991. The first group of the refugees are due to return home in February under a deal between the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) and a Somali team in Yemen.
Yemen said in the summer of last year it has deported more than 14,000 illegal aliens in one year.
